dedupe_keys.name: plans d alignements approuves sur voirie departementale

description: Plans d’alignements approuvés sur voirie départementale is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Enlargement reservations or alignment easements on departmental roads This data provides information on alignment plans approved by administrative decision for the benefit of the Department. More specifically, these are the boundaries between public roads and riparian properties set out in the plans for public utility easements annexed to the planning documents PLU or POS. Coverage: Département des Hauts-de-Seine. The portal shows the English title as "Approved alignment plans on departmental roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Its keywords include routes-departementales, paa, plans-dalignements-approuves, plans-locaux-durbanisme, plu, urbanisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
